data: In the top leftmost plot, which line represents 'exponential'?

The question asks us to identify which line represents the 'exponential' function in the top leftmost plot. From the caption, we know that the figure shows fitting errors (residual, deviance) of ten functions used in Fig.4 for Mexican presidents' speech to congress. The top leftmost plot is labeled as (A). In this plot, there are two lines: one solid line and one dashed line. According to the legend, the solid line represents the 'exponential' function, while the dashed line represents the 'power-law' function. Therefore, the line representing the 'exponential' function is the solid line.
